[artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies. This domain examines art-historical interpretation, not general political chronology.
